articles.summary: Executed a 15-year, 910 critical IT MW triple-net powered land lease with a leading Frontier AI Lab at Corsicana, representing approximately $28 billion in total contract value and approximately $1.8 billion in average annual rent over the initial term Riot has now leased 1,151 MW of critical IT capacity, representing approximately $38 billion of long-term contracted revenue Sold 20,264 bitcoin year-to-date for approximately $1.5 billion primarily to fund data center development; ended the quarter with $950.2 million in cash and bitcoin, and no equity raised in 2026 Quarterly revenue of $181.4 million, including $18.4 million of Data Center revenue CASTLE ROCK, Colo., Nov. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Riot Platforms, Inc. (NASDAQ: RIOT) (“Riot” or “the Company”), a vertically-integrated industry leader in digital infrastructure, specializing in the development and operation of large-scale data centers, reported financial results for the three-month period ended September 30, 2026.
